# EstateFlow MVP PostgreSQL schema

Use the full SQL block to import the schema through **Import → PostgreSQL** in dbdiagram.io. See the [database contracts](contracts.md) for the service behavior that goes with the schema.

```sql
-- EstateFlow MVP | PostgreSQL
-- IDs are UUIDs generated by the application before a write.
-- Account and engagement are owned by Engagement service.
-- Property and Agent resolve cross-service IDs through the owning API.

CREATE SCHEMA account;
CREATE SCHEMA property;
CREATE SCHEMA engagement;
CREATE SCHEMA agent;

-- ============================================================
-- 1. ACCOUNTS AND PROFILES
-- Cognito owns credentials. EstateFlow owns application identity.
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE account.accounts (
    id               uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    cognito_issuer   text NOT NULL,
    cognito_subject  text NOT NULL,
    status           varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
    created_at       timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

    UNIQUE (cognito_issuer, cognito_subject),
    CHECK (status IN ('active', 'disabled'))
);

CREATE TABLE account.profiles (
    account_id    uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES account.accounts(id),
    display_name  text NOT NULL,
    updated_at    timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

    CHECK (btrim(display_name) <> '')
);

-- ============================================================
-- 2. LISTINGS, REVISIONS, AND PRICING
-- Exactly three MVP property types: house, apartment, land.
-- Incomplete drafts are valid. Required fields are checked at publish.
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE property.listings (
    id                         uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    seller_account_id          uuid NOT NULL,
    create_action_id           uuid NOT NULL,
    current_draft_revision_id  uuid,
    current_showcase_id        uuid,
    created_at                 timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

    UNIQUE (seller_account_id, create_action_id)
);

-- Seed through a migration before creating listings.
-- Conversion factors are expressed in square metres per unit.
-- Treat these definitions as immutable.
CREATE TABLE property.area_units (
    code                 varchar(12) PRIMARY KEY,
    square_metres        numeric(22,12) NOT NULL CHECK (square_metres > 0),
    valid_for_floor_area boolean NOT NULL
);

INSERT INTO property.area_units (code, square_metres, valid_for_floor_area)
VALUES
    ('sq_m',    1,              true),
    ('sq_ft',   0.09290304,     true),
    ('perch',   25.29285264,    false),
    ('acre',    4046.8564224,   false),
    ('hectare', 10000,          false);

CREATE TABLE property.listing_revisions (
    id                       uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    listing_id               uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES property.listings(id),
    revision_no              integer NOT NULL CHECK (revision_no > 0),
    parent_revision_id       uuid,
    edit_action_id           uuid NOT NULL,
    created_by_account_id    uuid NOT NULL,
    created_at               timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

    property_type            varchar(16) NOT NULL,
    district                 text,
    town                     text,

    -- entered_price preserves the seller's input.
    -- total: entered_price is the total asking price.
    -- per_unit: entered_price is the asking price per price_area_unit.
    price_basis              varchar(16),
    entered_price            numeric(18,2),
    currency                 varchar(3),
    price_area_unit          varchar(12) REFERENCES property.area_units(code),
    price_negotiable         boolean,

    land_area                numeric(18,6),
    land_area_unit           varchar(12) REFERENCES property.area_units(code),
    land_area_approximate    boolean,
    floor_area               numeric(18,6),
    floor_area_unit          varchar(12) REFERENCES property.area_units(code),
    floor_area_approximate   boolean,

    bedroom_count            smallint CHECK (bedroom_count >= 0),
    bathroom_count           smallint CHECK (bathroom_count >= 0),
    attached_bathroom_count  smallint CHECK (attached_bathroom_count >= 0),
    separate_toilet_count    smallint CHECK (separate_toilet_count >= 0),
    house_storey_count       smallint CHECK (house_storey_count > 0),
    apartment_floor_no       smallint,
    ground_floor_bedrooms    smallint CHECK (ground_floor_bedrooms >= 0),

    parking_spaces           smallint CHECK (parking_spaces >= 0),
    covered_parking_spaces   smallint CHECK (covered_parking_spaces >= 0),
    vehicle_access           boolean,
    access_road_width        numeric(10,3) CHECK (access_road_width > 0),
    access_road_width_unit   varchar(4),
    construction_status      varchar(24),
    year_built               smallint CHECK (year_built > 0),
    furnishing_status        varchar(24),
    has_mains_water          boolean,
    has_well_water           boolean,
    has_electricity          boolean,
    has_garden               boolean,
    has_boundary_wall        boolean,

    UNIQUE (listing_id, id),
    UNIQUE (listing_id, revision_no),
    UNIQUE (listing_id, edit_action_id),

    FOREIGN KEY (listing_id, parent_revision_id)
        REFERENCES property.listing_revisions(listing_id, id),

    CHECK (property_type IN ('house', 'apartment', 'land')),
    CHECK (parent_revision_id IS NULL OR parent_revision_id <> id),
    CHECK (district IS NULL OR btrim(district) <> ''),
    CHECK (town IS NULL OR btrim(town) <> ''),
    CHECK (currency IS NULL OR currency ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'),
    CHECK (entered_price IS NULL OR entered_price > 0),
    CHECK (
        (price_basis IS NULL AND entered_price IS NULL
            AND currency IS NULL AND price_area_unit IS NULL)
        OR
        (price_basis IS NOT NULL AND entered_price IS NOT NULL
            AND currency IS NOT NULL AND (
                (price_basis = 'total' AND price_area_unit IS NULL)
                OR
                (price_basis = 'per_unit' AND property_type = 'land'
                    AND price_area_unit IS NOT NULL)
            ))
    ),

    CHECK ((land_area IS NULL) = (land_area_unit IS NULL)),
    CHECK ((floor_area IS NULL) = (floor_area_unit IS NULL)),
    CHECK (land_area IS NULL OR land_area > 0),
    CHECK (floor_area IS NULL OR floor_area > 0),
    CHECK (land_area IS NOT NULL OR land_area_approximate IS NULL),
    CHECK (floor_area IS NOT NULL OR floor_area_approximate IS NULL),
    CHECK (floor_area_unit IS NULL OR floor_area_unit IN ('sq_ft', 'sq_m')),
    CHECK ((access_road_width IS NULL) = (access_road_width_unit IS NULL)),
    CHECK (access_road_width_unit IS NULL OR access_road_width_unit IN ('ft', 'm')),
    CHECK (attached_bathroom_count <= bathroom_count),
    CHECK (ground_floor_bedrooms <= bedroom_count),
    CHECK (covered_parking_spaces <= parking_spaces),
    CHECK (house_storey_count IS NULL OR property_type = 'house'),
    CHECK (apartment_floor_no IS NULL OR property_type = 'apartment'),
    CHECK (construction_status IS NULL OR construction_status IN
           ('planned', 'under_construction', 'completed')),
    CHECK (furnishing_status IS NULL OR furnishing_status IN
           ('unfurnished', 'partly_furnished', 'furnished')),
    CHECK (
        property_type <> 'land'
        OR (floor_area IS NULL AND bedroom_count IS NULL
            AND bathroom_count IS NULL AND attached_bathroom_count IS NULL
            AND separate_toilet_count IS NULL AND ground_floor_bedrooms IS NULL
            AND furnishing_status IS NULL AND year_built IS NULL)
    )
);

ALTER TABLE property.listings
    ADD FOREIGN KEY (id, current_draft_revision_id)
    REFERENCES property.listing_revisions(listing_id, id);

-- ============================================================
-- 3. FLEXIBLE FACTS AND EVIDENCE
-- Standard fields retain their typed values on listing_revisions.
-- Extra facts use typed values here. Both can retain provenance.
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE property.fact_definitions (
    fact_key        text PRIMARY KEY,
    display_name    text NOT NULL,
    storage_kind    varchar(12) NOT NULL,
    value_kind      varchar(12) NOT NULL,
    canonical_unit  text,

    UNIQUE (fact_key, storage_kind, value_kind),
    CHECK (storage_kind IN ('column', 'flexible')),
    CHECK (value_kind IN ('number', 'boolean', 'text'))
);

CREATE TABLE property.fact_applicability (
    fact_key       text NOT NULL REFERENCES property.fact_definitions(fact_key),
    property_type  varchar(16) NOT NULL,

    PRIMARY KEY (fact_key, property_type),
    CHECK (property_type IN ('house', 'apartment', 'land'))
);

CREATE TABLE property.revision_facts (
    revision_id          uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES property.listing_revisions(id),
    fact_key             text NOT NULL,
    storage_kind         varchar(12) NOT NULL,
    value_kind           varchar(12) NOT NULL,
    evidence_state       varchar(12) NOT NULL,
    number_value         numeric,
    boolean_value        boolean,
    text_value           text,
    source_kind          text NOT NULL,
    source_account_id    uuid,
    source_answer_id     uuid,
    qualifier            text,
    certainty            text,
    approved_for_public  boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    approved_by          uuid,
    approved_at          timestamptz,

    PRIMARY KEY (revision_id, fact_key),
    FOREIGN KEY (fact_key, storage_kind, value_kind)
        REFERENCES property.fact_definitions(fact_key, storage_kind, value_kind),

    CHECK (evidence_state IN ('known', 'unknown', 'disputed')),
    CHECK ((approved_by IS NULL) = (approved_at IS NULL)),
    CHECK (NOT approved_for_public OR approved_by IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK (
        CASE
            WHEN storage_kind = 'column' OR evidence_state <> 'known'
                THEN num_nonnulls(number_value, boolean_value, text_value) = 0
            WHEN value_kind = 'number'
                THEN number_value IS NOT NULL
                    AND boolean_value IS NULL AND text_value IS NULL
            WHEN value_kind = 'boolean'
                THEN boolean_value IS NOT NULL
                    AND number_value IS NULL AND text_value IS NULL
            ELSE text_value IS NOT NULL
                    AND number_value IS NULL AND boolean_value IS NULL
        END
    )
);

-- ============================================================
-- 4. PHOTOS AND EDITABLE SHOWCASES
-- S3 holds the image bytes. Revisions retain the exact photo set.
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE property.photos (
    id                uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    listing_id        uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES property.listings(id),
    upload_action_id  uuid NOT NULL,
    object_key        text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    object_version    text,
    content_type      text,
    size_bytes        bigint CHECK (size_bytes > 0),
    upload_status     varchar(12) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
    created_at        timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    verified_at       timestamptz,

    UNIQUE (listing_id, id),
    UNIQUE (listing_id, upload_action_id),
    CHECK (upload_status IN ('pending', 'verified', 'rejected')),
    CHECK (upload_status <> 'verified' OR
           (verified_at IS NOT NULL AND size_bytes IS NOT NULL
            AND content_type IS NOT NULL))
);

CREATE TABLE property.revision_photos (
    listing_id     uuid NOT NULL,
    revision_id    uuid NOT NULL,
    photo_id       uuid NOT NULL,
    display_order  integer NOT NULL CHECK (display_order >= 0),

    PRIMARY KEY (revision_id, photo_id),
    UNIQUE (revision_id, display_order),
    FOREIGN KEY (listing_id, revision_id)
        REFERENCES property.listing_revisions(listing_id, id),
    FOREIGN KEY (listing_id, photo_id)
        REFERENCES property.photos(listing_id, id)
);

CREATE TABLE property.showcase_revisions (
    id                  uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    listing_id          uuid NOT NULL,
    source_revision_id  uuid NOT NULL,
    parent_showcase_id  uuid,
    source_job_id       uuid UNIQUE,
    action_id           uuid NOT NULL,
    headline            text NOT NULL CHECK (btrim(headline) <> ''),
    description         text NOT NULL CHECK (btrim(description) <> ''),
    highlights          jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    created_at          timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

    UNIQUE (listing_id, id),
    UNIQUE (id, source_revision_id),
    UNIQUE (listing_id, source_revision_id, id),
    UNIQUE (listing_id, action_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (listing_id, source_revision_id)
        REFERENCES property.listing_revisions(listing_id, id),
    FOREIGN KEY (listing_id, parent_showcase_id)
        REFERENCES property.showcase_revisions(listing_id, id),
    CHECK (jsonb_typeof(highlights) = 'array'),
    CHECK (parent_showcase_id IS NULL OR parent_showcase_id <> id)
);

CREATE TABLE property.showcase_photos (
    showcase_id         uuid NOT NULL,
    source_revision_id  uuid NOT NULL,
    photo_id            uuid NOT NULL,
    display_order       integer NOT NULL CHECK (display_order >= 0),
    caption             text,

    PRIMARY KEY (showcase_id, photo_id),
    UNIQUE (showcase_id, display_order),
    FOREIGN KEY (showcase_id, source_revision_id)
        REFERENCES property.showcase_revisions(id, source_revision_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (source_revision_id, photo_id)
        REFERENCES property.revision_photos(revision_id, photo_id)
);

ALTER TABLE property.listings
    ADD FOREIGN KEY (id, current_showcase_id)
    REFERENCES property.showcase_revisions(listing_id, id);

-- ============================================================
-- 5. PRIVATE PHONE NUMBERS, WRITTEN ADDRESS, AND GPS PIN
-- A replacement creates a new value-version ID. Existing grants
-- continue to identify exactly what the seller previously shared.
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE property.private_details (
    id                  uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    listing_id          uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES property.listings(id),
    detail_kind         varchar(20) NOT NULL,
    slot_no             smallint NOT NULL,
    current_version_id  uuid,

    UNIQUE (listing_id, detail_kind, slot_no),
    CHECK (
        (detail_kind = 'phone' AND slot_no BETWEEN 1 AND 3)
        OR (detail_kind IN ('written_address', 'map_pin') AND slot_no = 1)
    )
);

CREATE TABLE property.private_detail_versions (
    id                  uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    detail_id           uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES property.private_details(id),
    version_no          integer NOT NULL CHECK (version_no > 0),
    action_id           uuid NOT NULL,
    encrypted_value     bytea NOT NULL,
    encryption_key_ref  text NOT NULL,
    created_by          uuid NOT NULL,
    created_at          timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

    UNIQUE (detail_id, id),
    UNIQUE (detail_id, version_no),
    UNIQUE (detail_id, action_id),
    CHECK (octet_length(encrypted_value) > 0)
);

ALTER TABLE property.private_details
    ADD FOREIGN KEY (id, current_version_id)
    REFERENCES property.private_detail_versions(detail_id, id);

-- ============================================================
-- 6. PUBLICATION AND PUBLIC SEARCH
-- One publication identifies a matching listing + revision + showcase.
-- The pointer changes only after explicit seller publication.
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE property.publications (
    id                   uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    listing_id           uuid NOT NULL,
    listing_revision_id  uuid NOT NULL,
    showcase_id          uuid NOT NULL,
    published_by         uuid NOT NULL,
    action_id            uuid NOT NULL,
    published_at         timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

    UNIQUE (listing_id, id),
    UNIQUE (listing_id, action_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (listing_id, listing_revision_id, showcase_id)
        REFERENCES property.showcase_revisions(listing_id, source_revision_id, id)
);

CREATE TABLE property.current_publications (
    listing_id      uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    publication_id  uuid NOT NULL,

    FOREIGN KEY (listing_id, publication_id)
        REFERENCES property.publications(listing_id, id)
);

-- Property service locks the listing during publication and phone removal.
-- All types require district, town, currency, price, and 1-3 current phones.
-- House: land area, bedroom count, bathroom count required.
-- Apartment: unit floor area required; land area optional on every floor.
-- Land: land area required. Validate the total price can be calculated.
-- Check verified media, current revisions, and seller ownership in the
-- same publication operation. Historical revisions remain immutable.

CREATE VIEW property.public_listings AS
SELECT
    p.listing_id,
    p.listing_revision_id,
    p.showcase_id,
    p.published_at,
    r.property_type,
    r.district,
    r.town,
    r.currency,
    r.price_basis,
    r.entered_price,
    r.price_area_unit,
    CASE
        WHEN r.price_basis = 'total' THEN r.entered_price
        WHEN r.price_basis = 'per_unit' THEN
            round(r.entered_price * r.land_area *
                  land_unit.square_metres / price_unit.square_metres, 2)
    END AS total_asking_price,
    CASE
        WHEN r.price_basis = 'per_unit' THEN r.land_area_approximate
        ELSE false
    END AS total_derived_from_approximate_area,
    r.land_area,
    r.land_area_unit,
    r.land_area_approximate,
    r.floor_area,
    r.floor_area_unit,
    r.floor_area_approximate,
    r.bedroom_count,
    r.bathroom_count,
    s.headline,
    s.description,
    s.highlights
FROM property.current_publications cp
JOIN property.publications p ON p.id = cp.publication_id
JOIN property.listing_revisions r ON r.id = p.listing_revision_id
JOIN property.showcase_revisions s ON s.id = p.showcase_id
LEFT JOIN property.area_units land_unit ON land_unit.code = r.land_area_unit
LEFT JOIN property.area_units price_unit ON price_unit.code = r.price_area_unit;

-- ============================================================
-- 7. PROPERTY CHATS, SELLER CHATS, TURNS, AND MESSAGES
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE engagement.conversations (
    id                      uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    listing_id              uuid NOT NULL,
    participant_account_id  uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES account.accounts(id),
    chat_kind               varchar(20) NOT NULL,
    created_at              timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

    UNIQUE (listing_id, participant_account_id, chat_kind),
    UNIQUE (listing_id, id, chat_kind),
    CHECK (chat_kind IN ('buyer_property', 'seller_listing'))
);

CREATE TABLE engagement.turns (
    id                uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    conversation_id   uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES engagement.conversations(id),
    client_action_id  uuid NOT NULL,
    status            varchar(16) NOT NULL,
    created_at        timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    finished_at       timestamptz,

    UNIQUE (conversation_id, client_action_id),
    UNIQUE (conversation_id, id),
    CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'running', 'completed', 'failed'))
);

CREATE TABLE engagement.messages (
    id               uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    conversation_id  uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES engagement.conversations(id),
    turn_id          uuid,
    sequence_no      bigint NOT NULL CHECK (sequence_no > 0),
    message_kind     varchar(24) NOT NULL,
    write_action_id  uuid NOT NULL,
    body             text,
    created_at       timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

    UNIQUE (conversation_id, sequence_no),
    UNIQUE (conversation_id, write_action_id),
    UNIQUE (conversation_id, id),
    FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id, turn_id)
        REFERENCES engagement.turns(conversation_id, id),

    CHECK (
        (message_kind IN ('user_text', 'agent_reply') AND body IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        (message_kind IN ('share_card', 'inquiry_status',
                          'shared_answer', 'disclosure_status') AND body IS NULL)
    )
);

-- ============================================================
-- 8. GROUPED QUESTIONS, SHARE ANSWER, AND LATEST ANSWERS
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE engagement.inquiry_groups (
    id            uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    listing_id    uuid NOT NULL,
    fact_key      text NOT NULL CHECK (btrim(fact_key) <> ''),
    status        varchar(12) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
    opened_at     timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

    pending_slot  boolean GENERATED ALWAYS AS
                  (CASE WHEN status = 'pending' THEN true END) STORED,

    UNIQUE (listing_id, fact_key, pending_slot),
    UNIQUE (listing_id, id),
    UNIQUE (listing_id, fact_key, id),
    CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'answered', 'declined'))
);

CREATE TABLE engagement.inquiries (
    id                      uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    listing_id              uuid NOT NULL,
    group_id                uuid NOT NULL,
    buyer_conversation_id   uuid NOT NULL,
    chat_kind               varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'buyer_property',
    confirmation_action_id  uuid NOT NULL,
    original_question       text NOT NULL,
    confirmed_at            timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

    UNIQUE (buyer_conversation_id, confirmation_action_id),
    UNIQUE (id, group_id, buyer_conversation_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (listing_id, group_id)
        REFERENCES engagement.inquiry_groups(listing_id, id),
    FOREIGN KEY (listing_id, buyer_conversation_id, chat_kind)
        REFERENCES engagement.conversations(listing_id, id, chat_kind),
    CHECK (chat_kind = 'buyer_property'),
    CHECK (btrim(original_question) <> '')
);

-- A correction may originate from Seller Chat without a new buyer inquiry.
CREATE TABLE engagement.answer_proposals (
    id                        uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    listing_id                uuid NOT NULL,
    fact_key                  text NOT NULL CHECK (btrim(fact_key) <> ''),
    group_id                  uuid,
    seller_account_id         uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES account.accounts(id),
    seller_source_message_id  uuid REFERENCES engagement.messages(id),
    share_card_message_id     uuid UNIQUE REFERENCES engagement.messages(id),
    wording                   text NOT NULL CHECK (btrim(wording) <> ''),
    structured_value          jsonb NOT NULL,
    qualifier                 text,
    created_at                timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

    UNIQUE (listing_id, fact_key, id),
    FOREIGN KEY (listing_id, fact_key, group_id)
        REFERENCES engagement.inquiry_groups(listing_id, fact_key, id)
);

-- One immutable version for each seller Share answer action.
CREATE TABLE engagement.shared_answers (
    id                     uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    listing_id             uuid NOT NULL,
    fact_key               text NOT NULL,
    proposal_id            uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    supersedes_answer_id   uuid,
    shared_by_account_id   uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES account.accounts(id),
    share_action_id        uuid NOT NULL,
    shared_at              timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

    UNIQUE (shared_by_account_id, share_action_id),
    UNIQUE (listing_id, fact_key, id),
    FOREIGN KEY (listing_id, fact_key, proposal_id)
        REFERENCES engagement.answer_proposals(listing_id, fact_key, id),
    FOREIGN KEY (listing_id, fact_key, supersedes_answer_id)
        REFERENCES engagement.shared_answers(listing_id, fact_key, id),
    CHECK (supersedes_answer_id IS NULL OR supersedes_answer_id <> id)
);

CREATE TABLE engagement.current_answers (
    listing_id  uuid NOT NULL,
    fact_key    text NOT NULL,
    answer_id   uuid NOT NULL,

    PRIMARY KEY (listing_id, fact_key),
    FOREIGN KEY (listing_id, fact_key, answer_id)
        REFERENCES engagement.shared_answers(listing_id, fact_key, id)
);

CREATE TABLE engagement.inquiry_resolutions (
    id                 uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    listing_id         uuid NOT NULL,
    fact_key           text NOT NULL,
    group_id           uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    seller_account_id  uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES account.accounts(id),
    action_id          uuid NOT NULL,
    outcome            varchar(12) NOT NULL,
    answer_id          uuid,
    resolved_at        timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

    UNIQUE (seller_account_id, action_id),
    UNIQUE (group_id, id),
    FOREIGN KEY (listing_id, fact_key, group_id)
        REFERENCES engagement.inquiry_groups(listing_id, fact_key, id),
    FOREIGN KEY (listing_id, fact_key, answer_id)
        REFERENCES engagement.shared_answers(listing_id, fact_key, id),
    CHECK (outcome IN ('answered', 'declined')),
    CHECK ((outcome = 'answered') = (answer_id IS NOT NULL))
);

CREATE TABLE engagement.inquiry_deliveries (
    inquiry_id       uuid NOT NULL,
    resolution_id    uuid NOT NULL,
    group_id         uuid NOT NULL,
    conversation_id  uuid NOT NULL,
    message_id       uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    PRIMARY KEY (inquiry_id, resolution_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (inquiry_id, group_id, conversation_id)
        REFERENCES engagement.inquiries(id, group_id, buyer_conversation_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (group_id, resolution_id)
        REFERENCES engagement.inquiry_resolutions(group_id, id),
    FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id, message_id)
        REFERENCES engagement.messages(conversation_id, id)
);

-- First share: resolve the pending group, deliver to its original chats,
-- and set current_answers in one transaction.
-- Correction: create a new shared_answers row and replace current_answers.
-- Earlier messages keep their previous wording. No correction fan-out.
-- A fresh question, including one in an old chat, reads current_answers.

-- ============================================================
-- 9. BUYER-SPECIFIC PRIVATE DISCLOSURES
-- A phone request can grant one or more selected phone versions.
-- An exact-location request can grant the address, map pin, or both.
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE engagement.disclosure_requests (
    id                uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    listing_id        uuid NOT NULL,
    buyer_account_id  uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES account.accounts(id),
    request_kind      varchar(20) NOT NULL,
    action_id         uuid NOT NULL,
    status            varchar(12) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
    requested_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

    pending_slot      boolean GENERATED ALWAYS AS
                      (CASE WHEN status = 'pending' THEN true END) STORED,

    UNIQUE (buyer_account_id, action_id),
    UNIQUE (listing_id, buyer_account_id, request_kind, pending_slot),
    UNIQUE (id, request_kind),
    CHECK (request_kind IN ('phone', 'exact_location')),
    CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'granted', 'declined'))
);

CREATE TABLE engagement.disclosure_decisions (
    id                 uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    request_id         uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    request_kind       varchar(20) NOT NULL,
    seller_account_id  uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES account.accounts(id),
    action_id          uuid NOT NULL,
    outcome            varchar(12) NOT NULL,
    decided_at         timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

    UNIQUE (seller_account_id, action_id),
    UNIQUE (id, outcome, request_kind),
    FOREIGN KEY (request_id, request_kind)
        REFERENCES engagement.disclosure_requests(id, request_kind),
    CHECK (outcome IN ('granted', 'declined'))
);

CREATE TABLE engagement.disclosure_grants (
    decision_id       uuid NOT NULL,
    outcome           varchar(12) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'granted',
    request_kind      varchar(20) NOT NULL,
    detail_kind       varchar(20) NOT NULL,
    value_version_id  uuid NOT NULL,

    PRIMARY KEY (decision_id, value_version_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (decision_id, outcome, request_kind)
        REFERENCES engagement.disclosure_decisions(id, outcome, request_kind),
    CHECK (outcome = 'granted'),
    CHECK (
        (request_kind = 'phone' AND detail_kind = 'phone')
        OR
        (request_kind = 'exact_location'
            AND detail_kind IN ('written_address', 'map_pin'))
    )
);

-- On grant: verify listing ownership and exact version IDs through Property.
-- Commit the decision, at least one chosen version, and request status together.
-- On read: verify the requesting buyer, listing, and grant; fetch that
-- immutable version. Never substitute the latest phone/address/pin.

-- ============================================================
-- 10. AGENT RUNS AND BACKGROUND JOBS
-- One logical job can have up to three execution attempts.
-- Dispatcher publish attempts are counted separately.
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE agent.runs (
    id                uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    workflow          varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    correlation_id    uuid NOT NULL,
    parent_run_id     uuid REFERENCES agent.runs(id),
    job_id            uuid,
    actor_account_id  uuid NOT NULL,
    conversation_id   uuid,
    turn_id           uuid,
    status            varchar(16) NOT NULL,
    model_id          text,
    input_tokens      integer CHECK (input_tokens >= 0),
    output_tokens     integer CHECK (output_tokens >= 0),
    provider_ms       integer CHECK (provider_ms >= 0),
    failure_code      text,
    started_at        timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    finished_at       timestamptz,

    UNIQUE (job_id, id),
    CHECK (workflow IN ('seller_agent', 'buyer_agent',
                        'property_inspector', 'showcase_creator')),
    CHECK (status IN ('running', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'superseded')),
    CHECK (parent_run_id IS NULL OR parent_run_id <> id),
    CHECK (turn_id IS NULL OR conversation_id IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK (finished_at IS NULL OR finished_at >= started_at)
);

CREATE TABLE agent.jobs (
    id                        uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    job_kind                  varchar(24) NOT NULL,
    listing_id                uuid NOT NULL,
    input_revision_id         uuid NOT NULL,
    expected_showcase_id      uuid,
    source_inspection_job_id  uuid REFERENCES agent.jobs(id),
    originating_run_id        uuid REFERENCES agent.runs(id),

    -- Try again / Run on latest draft creates a new logical job.
    retry_of_job_id           uuid REFERENCES agent.jobs(id),

    requested_by_account_id   uuid NOT NULL,
    request_action_id         uuid NOT NULL,
    request_fingerprint       text NOT NULL,
    execution_scope           text NOT NULL,
    status                    varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued',
    available_at              timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    failure_code              text,
    created_at                timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    finished_at               timestamptz,

    UNIQUE (requested_by_account_id, request_action_id),
    CHECK (job_kind IN ('inspect_listing', 'generate_showcase')),
    CHECK (status IN ('queued', 'running', 'retry_wait',
                      'succeeded', 'failed', 'superseded')),
    CHECK (btrim(execution_scope) <> ''),
    CHECK (source_inspection_job_id IS NULL OR source_inspection_job_id <> id),
    CHECK (retry_of_job_id IS NULL OR retry_of_job_id <> id),
    CHECK (job_kind = 'generate_showcase'
           OR (expected_showcase_id IS NULL AND source_inspection_job_id IS NULL)),
    CHECK ((status IN ('succeeded', 'failed', 'superseded'))
           = (finished_at IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (finished_at IS NULL OR finished_at >= created_at)
);

ALTER TABLE agent.runs
    ADD FOREIGN KEY (job_id) REFERENCES agent.jobs(id);

-- Transactional outbox. Job acceptance commits the job and dispatch #1
-- together. The execution scope is obtained from the parent job.
CREATE TABLE agent.dispatches (
    id                 uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    job_id             uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES agent.jobs(id),
    dispatch_no        integer NOT NULL CHECK (dispatch_no > 0),
    available_at       timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    publish_attempts   integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (publish_attempts >= 0),
    last_attempt_at    timestamptz,
    last_error_code    text,
    sent_at            timestamptz,

    UNIQUE (job_id, dispatch_no)
);

-- An active claim is leased. Its token fences writes by an old worker.
-- Duplicate broker messages cannot allocate a fourth attempt.
CREATE TABLE agent.job_attempts (
    id                uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    job_id            uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES agent.jobs(id),
    attempt_no        smallint NOT NULL CHECK (attempt_no BETWEEN 1 AND 3),
    claim_token       uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    worker_id         text NOT NULL,
    run_id            uuid UNIQUE,
    status            varchar(20) NOT NULL,
    claimed_at        timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    heartbeat_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    lease_expires_at  timestamptz NOT NULL,
    finished_at       timestamptz,
    failure_code      text,

    active_slot       boolean GENERATED ALWAYS AS
                      (CASE WHEN status = 'running' THEN true END) STORED,

    UNIQUE (job_id, id),
    UNIQUE (job_id, attempt_no),
    UNIQUE (job_id, active_slot),
    FOREIGN KEY (job_id, run_id) REFERENCES agent.runs(job_id, id),
    CHECK (status IN ('running', 'succeeded', 'transient_failure',
                      'permanent_failure', 'expired', 'superseded')),
    CHECK (lease_expires_at > heartbeat_at),
    CHECK (heartbeat_at >= claimed_at),
    CHECK ((status = 'running') = (finished_at IS NULL)),
    CHECK (finished_at IS NULL OR finished_at >= claimed_at)
);

-- Save the validated result once, before a cross-service submission.
-- A replacement worker can finish delivery without regenerating output.
CREATE TABLE agent.job_results (
    job_id                      uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES agent.jobs(id),
    produced_by_attempt_id      uuid NOT NULL,
    validated_output            jsonb NOT NULL,
    saved_property_showcase_id  uuid,
    created_at                  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

    FOREIGN KEY (job_id, produced_by_attempt_id)
        REFERENCES agent.job_attempts(job_id, id),
    CHECK (jsonb_typeof(validated_output) = 'object')
);

-- ============================================================
-- SERVICE TRANSACTION CONTRACTS
-- ============================================================
-- 1. Draft edits: lock the listing or compare expected revision IDs.
--    Commit the new revision, evidence, photo set, and draft pointer together.
--    Accept verified photos only. Keep snapshot rows append-only by role.
--
-- 2. Showcase delivery: look up an existing source_job_id first.
--    If already saved, return the original result. Otherwise compare both
--    the expected draft and showcase pointers before writing a new draft.
--    A stale result becomes superseded; a seller can run on the latest draft.
--
-- 3. Worker claim: lock the job row. Verify environment, eligibility,
--    attempt budget, and any existing validated result before starting work.
--    Allocate attempts in order. Heartbeat and completion writes must match
--    the active claim token and an unexpired lease in the same transaction.
--
-- 4. Recovery: expire stale claims under the job lock. Reuse any saved
--    result or reconcile an already-applied Property write before declaring
--    failure. A transient failure can create another eligible dispatch.
--    A permanent failure or exhausted budget ends execution.
--    A queued-job reconciler can redispatch a job that never reached a worker.
--
-- 5. Broker: publish persistent messages using the job ID; mark sent only
--    after confirmed routing. Duplicate publication or delivery is expected.
--
-- 6. Authorization: derive actors from verified Cognito identity. Enforce
--    ownership, conversation membership, disclosure audience, and service
--    access at each API. Cross-service UUIDs deliberately have no SQL FK.
--
-- 7. Hosted cutover: stop local acceptance, drain local jobs and brokers,
--    shut down local stacks, then run hosted jobs in their own scope.
```
